name: wf-pricing
chats: How does our help desk pricing compare with Zendesk, Intercom and Freshdesk? Ours, per agent per month billed annually: Team $49, Growth $79, Professional $109. Zendesk Suite: $55, $89, $115. Intercom: $39, $99, $139. Freshdesk: $15, $49, $79. Line them up for a 10-agent team in a short table and give a one-line read. No files, no tools.

Four firms quoted our SOC 2 audit: Ridgeline $18,500 including a readiness review, Northgate $21,000, Clearpath $19,800, Avalon $24,000. Summarize them in a short table and pick one in a line. No files, no tools.
Outline a Q3 board update for a small help desk software company in five bullets. No files, no tools.
